### Important safety information

### Lingo

* * * *

The Lingo Glucose System is intended for users 18 years and older not on insulin. It is NOT intended
for diagnosis of diseases, including diabetes.

The Lingo program does not guarantee that everyone will achieve the same results as individual
responses may vary. Consult your healthcare professional before making changes to your diet or
exercise regime or if you have an eating disorder or a history of eating disorders.

The product images are representative only.

## Applying the power of science and technology

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]
Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System

#### Act. Improve. Repeat.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

### Bringing new possibilities to life

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

#### Initiatives

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

#### Acquisitions

From adding exciting new technologies to contributing new perspectives and skills to our extended
team, our focused acquisition strategy is essential as we accelerate the power of science and
technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

[Learn about acquisitions][72]

## Testing specialties

### Gastroenterology

###### Gastroenterology

Our integration with a world-renowned medical center equips us with patient experience that supports
development of disease-specific, algorithmic-based testing approaches that provide faster answers
for each patient. Whether screening patients or monitoring therapeutic management, our evaluations
cover the full-spectrum of gastroenterology testing.

### Genetics

###### Genetics

Mayo Clinic Laboratories has been providing meaningful results to individuals seeking genetic
answers. Rare genetic disorders can be among the most difficult conditions to diagnose. To provide
meaningful answers, our genetic testing is developed and supported by an integrated team of
clinical, genetic, and laboratory experts and uses precision technologies to reveal variations
related to diagnosis and treatment. Built around a tradition of placing patients’ needs first, our
testing generates personalized insights to elevate understanding of a patient’s condition.

### Hematology

###### Hematology

Our comprehensive test menu has been created to aid in diagnosis and treatment selection across the
full spectrum of hematologic disorders. We have developed and validated practice-based, data-driven
algorithms that improve patient care, increase efficiency, and reduce costs. Our hematology experts
continuously drive innovation in laboratory testing, developing new approaches and using new
technology to address patient needs they see every day in clinical practice.

### Immunology

###### Immunology

Immunology testing at Mayo Clinic Laboratories is supported by a multidisciplinary team of experts
who apply the latest research to propel the development of meaningful assays. These tests are used
to assist with disease identification, monitoring of disease processes, and monitoring and treatment
of rare immunologic illnesses.

### Microbiology & Infectious Diseases

###### Microbiology & Infectious Diseases

Our internationally renowned clinical microbiology laboratories offer a broad selection of tests
designed for rapid identification and in-depth characterization of the causative agents of
infectious diseases. We have developed and implemented culture techniques, immunoassays,
antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and molecular methods for rapid detection, identification, and
characterization, as well as provision of treatment guidance for microbial pathogens.

###### Neurology

### Oncology

###### Oncology

specific cancer types. Our comprehensive test menu includes evaluations that aid in providing both
diagnostic and prognostic information and treatment selection guidance across the full spectrum of
malignancies. By offering testing for both acquired and inherited cancers in one place, we serve as
the singular source for all cancer testing.

### Pathology

###### Pathology

Mayo Clinic has the most robust laboratory and pathology practice for cancer care in the world,
offering testing that spans diagnostic, theranostic, and prognostic approaches. Integrated teams of
Mayo Clinic pathologists provide expertise for every type and stage of cancer. Our consultative
practice strives to provide the highest quality of diagnostic pathology, utilizing only ancillary
testing that supports diagnosis in a cost-effective, expedient manner.

### Pediatrics

access to world-renowned Mayo Clinic specialists and over 150 years of experience informing
diagnoses and treatment plans to improve the health of children. Because we know it’s not only about
giving children the right care, it’s about giving them the best care.

## Testing specialties

### Gastroenterology

###### Gastroenterology

Our integration with a world-renowned medical center equips us with patient experience that supports
development of disease-specific, algorithmic-based testing approaches that provide faster answers
for each patient. Whether screening patients or monitoring therapeutic management, our evaluations
cover the full-spectrum of gastroenterology testing.

### Genetics

###### Genetics

Mayo Clinic Laboratories has been providing meaningful results to individuals seeking genetic
answers. Rare genetic disorders can be among the most difficult conditions to diagnose. To provide
meaningful answers, our genetic testing is developed and supported by an integrated team of
clinical, genetic, and laboratory experts and uses precision technologies to reveal variations
related to diagnosis and treatment. Built around a tradition of placing patients’ needs first, our
testing generates personalized insights to elevate understanding of a patient’s condition.

### Hematology

###### Hematology

Our comprehensive test menu has been created to aid in diagnosis and treatment selection across the
full spectrum of hematologic disorders. We have developed and validated practice-based, data-driven
algorithms that improve patient care, increase efficiency, and reduce costs. Our hematology experts
continuously drive innovation in laboratory testing, developing new approaches and using new
technology to address patient needs they see every day in clinical practice.

### Immunology

###### Immunology

Immunology testing at Mayo Clinic Laboratories is supported by a multidisciplinary team of experts
who apply the latest research to propel the development of meaningful assays. These tests are used
to assist with disease identification, monitoring of disease processes, and monitoring and treatment
of rare immunologic illnesses.

### Microbiology & Infectious Diseases

###### Microbiology & Infectious Diseases

Our internationally renowned clinical microbiology laboratories offer a broad selection of tests
designed for rapid identification and in-depth characterization of the causative agents of
infectious diseases. We have developed and implemented culture techniques, immunoassays,
antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and molecular methods for rapid detection, identification, and
characterization, as well as provision of treatment guidance for microbial pathogens.

### Neurology

###### Neurology

Mayo Clinic Laboratories is leading an evolution in neurology testing. Propelled by ongoing
discoveries of clinically relevant biomarkers, our laboratory scientists integrate research findings
into test development and implementation. Collaboration between our labs and the clinical practice
at Mayo Clinic supports development of clinically validated testing that delivers actionable answers
for patients.

### Oncology

###### Oncology

Mayo Clinic Laboratories takes the lead in designing and optimizing oncology testing based on
specific cancer types. Our comprehensive test menu includes evaluations that aid in providing both
diagnostic and prognostic information and treatment selection guidance across the full spectrum of
malignancies. By offering testing for both acquired and inherited cancers in one place, we serve as
the singular source for all cancer testing.

### Pathology

###### Pathology

Mayo Clinic has the most robust laboratory and pathology practice for cancer care in the world,
offering testing that spans diagnostic, theranostic, and prognostic approaches. Integrated teams of
Mayo Clinic pathologists provide expertise for every type and stage of cancer. Our consultative
practice strives to provide the highest quality of diagnostic pathology, utilizing only ancillary
testing that supports diagnosis in a cost-effective, expedient manner.

### Pediatrics

###### Pediatrics

Mayo Clinic Laboratories understands your need to deliver timely and exceptional care to your
pediatric patients. That’s why we deliver the most patient-focused reference lab experience
possible. Unlike other reference labs, we offer advanced and accurate testing methods supported by
access to world-renowned Mayo Clinic specialists and over 150 years of experience informing
diagnoses and treatment plans to improve the health of children. Because we know it’s not only about
giving children the right care, it’s about giving them the best care.

# Welcome to Alatkar Maternity and Eye Hospital, Hadapsar, Pune

Alatkar Maternity and Eye Hospital

**Alatkar Maternity & Eye Hospital in Pune**, born in 1997, is a healthcare institution built on a
foundation of compassion, expertise, and community integration for last 27 years where **Dr. Anil
Alatkar** and **Dr. Anita Alatkar** have worked untiringly to bring together state-of-the-art
technology and trained experienced personnel. It stands as a beacon of comprehensive care, weaving
together the threads of maternity and ophthalmology services to create a place where health, hope,
and healing converge for the people of Pune and beyond.

##### Professional Achievements

Dr Anil Alatkar has a rich history of accomplishments and contributions in the field of
ophthalmology. His expertise is exemplified by:
* Fellowship in Aravind Eye Institute, Madurai
* Fellowship in Sankara Nethralaya, Chennai
* FRCS Part 1 from the UK

Frequently Asked Questions?
[Dr.img]
What procedures does Alatkar Hospital offer in laparoscopic surgery?
Alatkar Hospital offers a range of laparoscopic procedures including laparoscopic cholecystectomy
(gallbladder removal), laparoscopic appendectomy, laparoscopic hernia repair, and laparoscopic
hysterectomy among others.
What gynecological services are available at Alatkar Hospital?
Alatkar Hospital provides comprehensive gynecological services including routine check-ups, Pap
smears, family planning counseling, management of menstrual disorders, prenatal care, and treatment
for gynecological conditions such as endometriosis and fibroids.
What ophthalmological services does Alatkar Hospital offer?
Alatkar Hospital provides a wide range of ophthalmological services including comprehensive eye
examinations, cataract surgery, glaucoma treatment, diabetic eye care, pediatric ophthalmology, and
LASIK surgery for vision correction.
Are there specialized services for maternal care at Alatkar Hospital?
Yes, Alatkar Hospital offers specialized maternal care services including antenatal care, postnatal
care, high-risk pregnancy management, and childbirth education classes to ensure the health and
well-being of both mother and baby.

# Welcome to Alatkar Maternity and Eye Hospital, Hadapsar, Pune

Alatkar Maternity and Eye Hospital

**Alatkar Maternity & Eye Hospital in Pune**, born in 1997, is a healthcare institution built on a
foundation of compassion, expertise, and community integration for last 27 years where **Dr. Anil
Alatkar** and **Dr. Anita Alatkar** have worked untiringly to bring together state-of-the-art
technology and trained experienced personnel. It stands as a beacon of comprehensive care, weaving
together the threads of maternity and ophthalmology services to create a place where health, hope,
and healing converge for the people of Pune and beyond.

##### Professional Achievements

Dr Anil Alatkar has a rich history of accomplishments and contributions in the field of
ophthalmology. His expertise is exemplified by:
* Fellowship in Aravind Eye Institute, Madurai
* Fellowship in Sankara Nethralaya, Chennai
* FRCS Part 1 from the UK

Frequently Asked Questions?
[Dr.img]
What procedures does Alatkar Hospital offer in laparoscopic surgery?
Alatkar Hospital offers a range of laparoscopic procedures including laparoscopic cholecystectomy
(gallbladder removal), laparoscopic appendectomy, laparoscopic hernia repair, and laparoscopic
hysterectomy among others.
What gynecological services are available at Alatkar Hospital?
Alatkar Hospital provides comprehensive gynecological services including routine check-ups, Pap
smears, family planning counseling, management of menstrual disorders, prenatal care, and treatment
for gynecological conditions such as endometriosis and fibroids.
What ophthalmological services does Alatkar Hospital offer?
Alatkar Hospital provides a wide range of ophthalmological services including comprehensive eye
examinations, cataract surgery, glaucoma treatment, diabetic eye care, pediatric ophthalmology, and
LASIK surgery for vision correction.
Are there specialized services for maternal care at Alatkar Hospital?
Yes, Alatkar Hospital offers specialized maternal care services including antenatal care, postnatal
care, high-risk pregnancy management, and childbirth education classes to ensure the health and
well-being of both mother and baby.

# For Insights Consultancy Report Topics

[For Insights Consultancy][59] is a resourceful market research and consulting service provider, who
has rich and varied experiences in different types of industries. We work with top-notch research
providers to cover the increasing demand for market research. The focus of our team at For Insights
Consultancy is on data and authenticity, bridging gaps in the market, and supporting business
expansion. Being different from other companies, we are customer-driven and put employees and
customers first

At For Insights Consultancy, our Consulting and Advisory Services are dedicated to providing
business leaders with the necessary support to deal with challenges, take advantage of the
situations, and achieve strategic objectives. We focus on paired-down solutions, helping clients
across industries to take the right impactful decisions backed by data.

## ## **Welcome to the NSQAP Participant Portal**
## 
## #### **Newborn Screening identifies conditions that can affect a child's long-term health or
## #### survival. CDC's Newborn Screening and Molecular Biology Branch manages the Newborn Screening
## #### Quality Assurance Program (NSQAP) to enhance and maintain the quality and accuracy of
## #### newborn screening results. The program provides training, consultation, guidelines, and
## #### dried blood spot proficiency testing and quality control materials to state public health
## #### laboratories and other laboratories responsible for newborn screening in the U.S. and many
## #### other countries.**
## 
## #### **A2LA Accredited PT Provider**
## 
## [Request Participation ]
## 
## ##### **CDC's Newborn Screening and Molecular Biology Branch(NSMBB) has been granted ISO/IEC
## ##### 17043 accrediation by the American Association for Laboratory Accreditation (A2LA). Please
## ##### consult A2LA Certification #4190.01 for a list of accrediated NSMBB proficiency testing
## ##### programs.**

# Newborn Screening

Neonatal screening or Newborn Screening involves the screening of newborns in the first days of
their lives for inborn errors of metabolism and certain disorders that can hinder the normal
development of the baby. These disorders, are not apparent at the time of the baby's birth, but have
potential to cause permanent neurological, cognitive, tactile and physical damage in the child.
Early detection of such diseases enable initiating of suitable interventions to prevent concerning
conditions in the long run. Trivitron provides a wide range Newborn Screening instruments, including
Modular & Fully Automated NBS Instrumentation, manual & automated equipment and reagent kits.
Trivitron's Diagnostic division Labsystems Diagnostics OY occupies the second place in the world
when it comes to New Born Screening Technology.

# Life Sciences

Life Sciences represent a multifaceted domain of scientific exploration that encompasses the study
of living organisms, their intricate processes, and the application of this knowledge to diverse
fields. This dynamic field holds the key to understanding life at its most fundamental level, and
its applications extend to various crucial areas, including medicine, biotechnology, environmental
science, and more. The field has also revolutionized our understanding of genetics, evolution, and
the very building blocks of life itself. Advances in genomics and proteomics have paved the way for
breakthroughs in personalized medicine, where treatments and therapies can be tailored to an
individual's genetic makeup. Life Sciences is the heart of contemporary research, driving
innovations that improve human health, protect the environment, and advance our knowledge of life's
complexities. The field's wide-ranging applications continue to shape our future and hold the
promise of even more groundbreaking discoveries as our understanding of life's intricate mechanisms
deepens. Welcome to Labsystems Diagnostics Life Sciences services, your gateway to cutting-edge
molecular tools that empower scientific discovery. In this specialized domain, we offer two key
product categories that are fundamental to countless life science applications: Custom
Oligonucleotides and Protein Enzymes. We provide the solutions to drive innovations in healthcare,
research, and biotechnology. With custom Oligonucleotides and top-quality Protein Enzymes, we assist
you to accelerate your scientific breakthroughs.

## Our Products

[Core Diagnostics]

#### [Core Diagnostics][43]

With a commitment to excellence, we offer a wide range of products that meet the rigorous standards
of the medical industry. From cutting-edge analyzers to reliable reagents and consumables, we have
everything you need to support accurate and efficient laboratory testing. Our comprehensive
portfolio caters to various areas, including hematology, chemistry, microbiology, immunology, and
more.

[Allied Diagnostics]

#### [Allied Diagnostics][44]

Our Allied Diagnostics Division is committed to delivering quality Diagnostic Solutions for
specialized facilities, extending beyond traditional clinical laboratories. For Blood bank, we
ensure blood safety for patients while supporting the essential work of blood bank healthcare
providers. Our comprehensive product selection equips your laboratory to enhance both blood safety
and accessibility. Additionally, we actively contribute to National Healthcare programs, such as
Newborn Screening, facilitating early identification of genetic anomalies for our nation's future
generations. We also offer Point of Care testing solutions, ensuring high quality testing right at
the patient's side.

[Life Science]

#### [Life Science][45]

A comprehensive range of high-quality diagnostic supplies and solutions to optimize your research
workflow and achieve accurate and reliable results. From genomics, proteomics, or other disciplines,
our portfolio includes reagents, kits, consumables, and equipment from reputable manufacturers. We
ensure to provide necessary tools and resources to drive your research forward.

[Food and Veterinary]

#### [Food and Veterinary Testing][46]

We know the critical importance of food safety and veterinary in safeguarding public health and
ensuring the well-being of animals. Whether you’re a food manufacturer, laboratory, or veterinary
clinic, we bring you solutions you will need to ensure compliance with industry standards.

HAS YOUR BABY SCREENED POSITIVE FOR MLD? click here
Having a new baby is an exciting time.  You’ve probably taken your baby home and spent lots of time
loving them, admiring how perfect and cute they are, and adjusting to being a family. Then, a phone
call comes, you go to the doctor, and you are told your beautiful baby has screened positive for
MLD. What does that mean? MLD, what’s that? Your world is turned upside down. You experience a barge
of emotions: disbelief, shock, confusion, uncertainty to name a few. You don’t know where to turn.
We are glad you found us … we’ve been in your shoes and can relate to all you are feeling. We want
to help! We can connect you with experienced knowledgeable resources to answer your questions and
guide you efficiently through the next steps. **NEXT STEPs**
1. **Diagnostic Confirmation – **Click on DIAGNOSTIC CONFIRMATION *(below)* for more information
2. **Learn about MLD** – We know you are Google’ing MLD that’s probably how you found us here.
   1. * [Quick video][14] – MLD Overview
      * [MLD-101 …][15] Learn more about MLD here
3. **MLD Experts** – Get connected with MLD experts
4. **Local team** – Build an informed local MLD care team
5. **Investigate Therapies** – Learn about and consider therapeutic options for your baby to have a
   good quality of life.
**Click to Connect**  and an expert who will help you through these next steps.
DIAGNOSTIC CONFIRMATION

A positive newborn screen result needs to be confirmed to be 100% sure your baby has MLD, and to try
to identify what form of MLD they have.

**NEXT STEP** – Get a formal **Diagnostic Confirmation**.

**Screening and Diagnostic confirmation … what’s the difference?**
Newborn screening is a high throughput public health screening program using dried blood spots to
identify babies who may have certain medical conditions. Most modern MLD NBS programs have second
and third-tier testing to minimize false positives while allowing no false negatives.

A Diagnostic Confirmation is a very specific and more detailed test of your baby usually using whole
blood and urine or targeted genomic sequencing to eliminate the NBS false positives, confirm MLD,
and in many cases identify the form of MLD your baby has which is important when making therapy and
clinical care decisions. Some of data used in a formal Diagnostic Confirmation may come from your
baby’s NBS screen.

### NEWBORN SCREENING FOR METACHROMATIC LEUKODYSTROPHY

After nearly a decade of work, an MLD newborn screen has been developed, tested in de-identified
pilot studies, and is now being used for identified baby pilot studies.

The current screening flow consists of three in-lab screening tests … blood sulfatide levels, ARSA
enzyme levels, and genomic sequencing … to try to eliminate false positives before the family is
notified.

### ANNOUNCEMENTS

**Since MLD newborn screening launched** in parts of Germany the summer of 2020, it is now live in
two US states – New York and Pennsylvania.

enzyme levels, and genomic sequencing … to try to eliminate false positives before the family is
notified.

## What We Do

MTRC has been providing reimbursement, health economic and evidence synthesis services to the
medical device and in-vitro diagnostics industry in Europe since 2017. 

[ Reimbursement Analysis ][27]

Coding, payment mechanism, reimbursement tariffs, policy and HTA considerations in 14 European
countries

[ Learn more ][28]
[ Market Access Strategy ][29]

Pathways to establish reimbursement, funding and obtain endorsement in the HTA programs in 14
European countries

[ Learn more ][30]
[ Evidence Gap Analysis ][31]

Strategic analysis of the sufficiency of evidence to obtain reimbursement and HTA approval in Europe
and recommendations about evidence generation

[ Learn more ][32]
[ Value Dossiers ][33]

Essential tool to support market access and marketing efforts through the lifecycle of the product

[ Learn more ][34]
[ Health Economic Modeling ][35]

Early and comprehensive decision-analytic models to determine economic value proposition and inform
healthcare decision-makers

[ Learn more ][36]

Subscribe to our newsletter to get bi-weekly updates key reimbursement/HTA news items

#### Ongoing HTAs by Skåne University Hospital in Sweden as of July 2026

][41]
As of July 2026, the Skåne University Hospital (HTA South) is working on health technology
assessments in several areas, including neuromodulation, nephrology, and diagnostic imaging.
Although HTA conclusions are generally not binding on hospitals, they may influence clinical
practice and support regional coverage recommendations.
[ ][42]
23 Jul 2026
[

#### Market Access Director-for-Hire for MedTech companies

][43]
MTRC is introducing a Market Access Director-for-Hire model in collaboration with Markus Siebert,
Partner of MTRC and Head of Metis Market Access Consulting. The model gives MedTech companies
flexible access to senior market access leadership to support European launches, internal
decision-making, and strategy implementation.
[ ][44]
23 Jul 2026
[

#### UK Life Sciences Sector Plan progress and next steps as of July 2026

][45]
On July 9, 2026, the UK Government published its first annual progress report on the Life Sciences
Sector Plan, launched in July 2025. The report outlines progress and next steps across actions
intended to strengthen research and development, attract investment, and accelerate health
innovation and NHS reform. The key developments include the launch of the National HealthTech Access
Programme, and the introduction of Value Based Procurement guidance.
[See all news][46]

## European Coverage

MTRC routinely supports multi-country projects across 14 major European markets, helping clients
compare reimbursement, payer, HTA, evidence and health economic requirements through one consistent
specialist partner.

Core markets include Austria, Belgium, Denmark, England, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy,
the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland.

## **Newborn screenings save babies, one foot at a time.**

For new parents nothing is more exciting than being able to take their brand-new baby. Conversely,
nothing is more devastating than learning down the road that your child has a terrible disease that
could have been detected before the baby left the hospital. Newborn screening is a very simple
procedure that takes only a moment of time – with a simple prick of the heel you may avoid lifelong
suffering for your child. If you are the parents of a baby on the way, you’re encouraged to find out
all you can about newborn screening.

Save Babies Through Screening, Inc. is a parent-run, nonprofit foundation dedicated to making sure
every newborn baby in the United States undergoes comprehensive and effective screening for a
variety of diseases that are usually hidden at birth. The Foundation pursues its mission through the
education of parents, pediatric healthcare workers, lawmakers, and institutional policymakers. Our
educational programs emphasize the importance of newborn screening through comprehensive testing to
identify disorders and initiate treatment promptly when necessary. We invite you to explore the site
and learn – it could save a baby’s life!

# Welcome to SMA UK

## About SMA UK

At SMA UK, we are committed to supporting everyone affected by SMA so that they have access to the
best care, support and treatment and there will be no barriers preventing full inclusion in society.

Watch our short film here.

## Newborn Screening for SMA Takes Another Major Step Forward

Today marks another landmark moment in the journey towards ensuring every baby born with spinal
muscular atrophy (SMA) has the opportunity to receive life-changing treatment before symptoms
develop. 

[ Read more here > ][88]
[NBS in England]

#### **Find out more about the work we do**

[2]

### Newborn screening for SMA

There is clear evidence that early diagnosis and treatment of SMA leads to better outcomes. Early
detection of the condition is critical. Read more about our work in this area here.

[flexi grants]

### FlexiGrants

Our FlexiGrants support all those living with SMA. We have two grant schemes which are open to all.
Applications may be made to one or both. Decisions are made as quickly as possible.

[SPOT SMA PLAIN]

### SpotSMA

SMA UK’s new symptom awareness campaign! Through SpotSMA, we aim to equip healthcare visitors and
community practitioners with the knowledge and confidence to recognise early signs of SMA.

[3]

### X8 off road wheelchair for hire!

We are delighted to be able to offer the SMA Community a new X8 off road wheelchair to hire for
free. Find out more here.

[images says picnic in the park 2026]

### Picnic in the Park!

Picnic in the Park is back for 2026! Find out more about the events this year and register for free
now!

[online community calls]

### Community Connect

Join one of our online support sessions open to anyone affected by SMA.

[Hand and heart icon]

## Who We Are

**Travere Therapeutics is a patient-centered biopharmaceutical company that stands with rare disease
communities every step of the way.**

Our mission extends beyond developing therapies—we are deeply committed to supporting patients,
caregivers, and advocates through meaningful partnerships that foster education, connection, and
hope. From the pre-clinical stage onward, we engage directly with the communities we serve to
understand their needs and co-create solutions that make a difference in their lives.

### Serve with Care

## Our Vision in Action

Trivitron delivers integrated, adaptable technology that strengthens healthcare from remote
communities to advanced hospitals — giving every clinician the tools for faster, more confident
decisions worldwide.

### Public Health & Screening

Early Detection at Population Scale. Scalable screening to detect disease early and protect
communities. From newborn screening to outbreak diagnostics, we empower national programs with
portable, cost-effective systems saving lives in resource-limited settings.

### Modern Laboratory Solutions

Precision Diagnostics, Accelerated Workflows. High-throughput diagnostic systems built for accuracy,
speed, and seamless automation. From routine to specialized tests, our advanced IVD platforms and
complete range of healthcare solutions deliver fast, reliable results that drive better clinical
decisions - globally.

### Hospitals and Clinics

Seamless technology for frontline care. Integrated medical technology solutions for confident,
real-time care. From patient monitors and ventilators to point-of-care devices, our modular systems
integrate effortlessly across rural clinics and tertiary hospitals.

### AI Solutions

AI That Works in the Real World. Practical AI for faster, more accurate diagnostics and smarter
workflows. From radiology image enhancement to predictive lab analytics, our clinically validated
tools integrate seamlessly into daily practice.
